_question: Has each source document's CONTENT been indexed — not merely its path cited?
_why_this_differs_from_file_coverage_aud: file-coverage-audit.json counts a file as processed when its path appears in any index artifact. A path can be cited by a document nobody opened; that is how the v1 index reported full coverage while all 33 scope narratives sat unread. This audit accepts only extracted text or stored content-derived evidence.

_tiers.EXTRACTED: Full text pulled into a derived artifact on disk.
_tiers.READ: Content demonstrably opened — stored rationale, quotation or diff.
_tiers.METADATA: Only filename-derived facts recorded. Document unopened.
_tiers.DERIVED: Artifact this pipeline produced, not a source document.
